hosted_ci.note: The authoritative 3.11/3.12/3.13 proof (loop-prompt section 3). The first run failed on the pull request and is kept here because what it found is a real defect in this item, not flake: the runner image carries tsc 7.0.2 on PATH (this machine carries none, so the registry path is used), and on TypeScript 7 a tsconfig.json beside a file named on the command line raises error TS5112 - the run exits 1 having checked nothing, and no diagnostic carries a file. The verdict rule read only filed diagnostics, so it saw none in the example and called the negative control a pass. Two fixes landed on the same branch: the repository's configuration file is no longer staged into the workspace, and a non-zero exit with no filed diagnostic is NOT_VERIFIED. A new test stages a configuration file deliberately and asserts the outcome is never EXECUTED.
